thread:
Rohit (Recruiter): Need urgent help. Candidate for SWE2 (UK) has work-visa slot earlier than expected and can start 2026-04-02 if we confirm offer. Their counter asks for band parity (£118k vs our offer £110k) or a provisional bridge until comp panel meets. Deadline: candidate gives notice by EOD.
Anya (People Ops): quick numbers pls (redact PII) + what they want exactly?
Rohit (Recruiter): Offer: base £110k + 10% bonus; band top £116k. Candidate counter: £118k. Asks either bump to £118k or one-time bridging sign-on £1,500 + earlier start 2026-04-02. Also asks when benefits (pension/health) kick in.
Aisha (Hiring Manager): This hire unblocks our EU infra launch. I can justify a provisional bridge sign-on and earlier start. Prefer one-time payment to avoid changing base. Will sign justification.
Sofia (Comp): Policy: temporary bridging payments allowed for exceptional market/counter offers. Typical path: one-time sign-on or provisional monthly top-up for up to 60 days. Requires Comp approval + VP Eng + Finance + Legal review for clawback wording. Recommend one-time £2k cap for UK hires.
Mobility (Relocation): If start 2026-04-02, relocation bookings need confirmation by 2026-03-29 to hit move windows. We need a written start date in the offer to begin work permit logistic.
Legal: We'll need clawback and conditional language if we do provisional payment. Also confirm that visa start date is not earlier than work authorization effective date. Can draft clause quickly.
Finance: Payroll cutoff for Apr runs is 2026-04-03. If payment included in first payroll, paperwork must be submitted by Apr 1. Emergency payroll runs are costly. Prefer lump sign-on on first payroll.
offer-bot: Automated check: "Action: provisional sign-on + start date change. Required approvals: comp@, vp-engi@, finance@, legal@. Recommended max 60 days. Candidate deadline: EOD. Routing ETA: 24-48h."
Anya (People Ops): Proposed language: keep base £110k, add one-time provisional sign-on £1,800 payable on first payroll if candidate starts by 2026-04-02; clause: final comp review by 2026-06-01 and repayment pro rata if uplift not approved or if employee leaves within 6 months. Also include benefits effective dates: pension auto-enroll first payroll, private health coverage effective first of month after start. Sending to Legal + Comp + Finance now.
Sofia (Comp): I can approve provisional sign-on £1,800 as long as VP Eng signs off on business justification and Hiring Manager confirms budget. I'll prepare exception memo.
Aisha (Hiring Manager): Budget confirmed from hiring discretionary. I'm sending VP Eng a note for expedited approval and adding business justification (launch timeline impact).
Rohit (Recruiter): I'll tell candidate we have provisional approval pending VP/Legal/Finance sign-off and that relocation planning can begin. They appreciate rapid response.
Legal: Drafted provisional clause and clawback wording, sending to People Ops. Note: ensure language ties payment to actual start and visa clearance.
Finance: Confirmed payroll timing; if paperwork submitted by Apr 1 we can include sign-on on first payroll. If later, it will be next cycle. We'll expedite if VP approves today.
Anya (People Ops): Logging to exceptions tracker and attaching redacted docs. If VP approves within 6h, we can issue formal revised offer. Otherwise we'll communicate conditional provisional approval to candidate so relocation isn't stalled. :white_check_mark:
